name: Filled Tainted Ooze Jar
summary: In Felwood, a Filled Tainted Ooze Jar carries samples of corruption to Ironforge. The samples may help explain how life began on Azeroth.

sections.title: Slime of the Corrupted Wood
sections.body: Across northern Kalimdor, tainted oozes bear Felwood’s lingering corruption. Gnomish researchers provide jars to hold them safely. Most travelers keep clear of these noxious creatures, yet their remains yield samples for natural philosophy and biological study far from the blighted woods.

sections.title: Geardawdle's Grand Theory
sections.body:
Laris Geardawdle, a gnome scholar with the Explorers' League in Ironforge, gathers the samples. The commonness of slimes fascinates him, and he has seen the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society take an interest in them too.

Many scholars dismiss Geardawdle's theory. He believes slimes and oozes may be primal secretions tied to Azeroth's creation. He seeks proof, and a place among dwarven scholars after Gnomeregan's tragic fall.

faq.q: What is inside a Filled Tainted Ooze Jar?
faq.answer: A Filled Tainted Ooze Jar holds a fresh sample from the remains of a Tainted Ooze native to Felwood, sealed in a gnomish collection jar.
Laris Geardawdle, a gnome researcher with the Explorers' League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, wants the samples for his natural history studies.

faq.q: Why is Laris Geardawdle studying oozes?
aliases: why does the gnome want ooze
faq.answer: Geardawdle saw the Royal Apothecary Society gathering slime samples and set out to understand their nature. He believes oozes are primordial secretions tied to Azeroth's creation, and hopes to earn a name as a scientist in Ironforge.

aliases: where do i fill the jar
faq.answer: You gather the samples in Felwood by defeating Tainted Oozes, then using an empty containment jar on their remains.

angles.text: As a gnome refugee in Ironforge, your scientific work with the Explorers' League can prove your worth and repay dwarven hospitality after Gnomeregan's tragedy.
As an Alliance scout, you watch the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society closely. Learning why the Undercity gathers slime across the continents is a key intelligence priority.

attribution: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
